description: This file defines the EntityExpr class, which implements the EntityCondition interface and represents infix condition expressions used in building database query conditions within the OFBiz framework. It includes constructors, condition validation, and methods for generating SQL snippets and type checking.

classes.name: EntityExpr
classes.description: Represents an infix condition expression used for building query conditions in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: EntityExpr
methods.description: Constructor for creating an infix comparison expression with validation for nulls and operator compatibility.

methods.name: EntityExpr
methods.description: Constructor for creating a combined EntityCondition expression with validation.

methods.name: getLhs
methods.description: Returns the left-hand side of the expression.

methods.name: getOperator
methods.description: Returns the operator used in the expression.

methods.name: getRhs
methods.description: Returns the right-hand side of the expression.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the operator indicates an empty condition.

methods.name: makeWhereString
methods.description: Generates the SQL WHERE clause string for this condition.

methods.name: mapMatches
methods.description: Checks if the condition matches a given map of values.

methods.name: checkCondition
methods.description: Validates the condition against the entity model.

methods.name: freeze
methods.description: Returns a frozen (immutable) version of the condition.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor for traversing or processing the condition.

methods.name: checkRhsType
methods.description: Validates the type of the right-hand side against the entity model and delegator.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another EntityExpr object.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code for the object.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the condition.
